Bugfixes.change_log: Fixed a major issue with Resource ValidationErrors not displaying for resources that had been reordered and not indexed yet.

Changes.change_log: The Resource `language` field now renders as a Select2 in the webform. You can no longer define `zxx` ("No linguistic content; Not applicable") language alongside other languages, this will raise a ValidationError.
Added test coverage for all of the Recombinant resource name and package type redirects/aliases.

Features.change_log: When adding a link Resource to a CSV or TSV, a guidance alert will now display copy describing API enablement if the user uploads to our system instead.
Added styling for a new `alert-guidance` alert type.
Resource `description` field has now been added to our Schemas and webforms. Form fields display in a new "Semantic Metadata Fields for Resources" accordion section in the Resource webform.
There are now webpage redirects for Recombinant dataset types. E.g. `/dataset/ati` would redirect to the published Combined dataset page for "ATI Summaries"

`package_show`, `resource_show`, `datastore_info`, and `datastore_search` now support aliases for Recombinant dataset types and resource names. E.g. `resource_show?id=ati` and `datastore_search?resource_id=ati` will query the `published_resource_id` for the Combined data of "ATI Summaries"
There are now webpage redirects for Recombinant resource names. E.g. `/resource/ati` would redirect to the published Combined resource page for "ATI Summaries"
